# Main's World public developer catalog

There are no public, self-service Main's World API endpoints to call today.
No base URL, credential, sandbox, public endpoint, or MCP endpoint exists.

The Connectives preview is read-only release documentation from the restricted normative source revision 3da5ce3fb92dc63910a6b59dabd817f15097d35f. It is not a runtime API and provides neither activation nor access.

## Local preview snapshots

- /api/connectives/v1/openapi.json (SHA-256: ca58c4f5166f09ff59fa5009a172d29536bc6c3b2552ad239b7193fce061380e)
- /api/connectives/v1/discord-connected-group-membership.json (SHA-256: 4043b1ef41de71271352145f6a8fbb3e400e3d34e9d09d070d6b5791e78ca1db)
- /api/connectives/v1/luma-vibe-candidate.json (SHA-256: 499d12a33183ce6fed9335fa3021d79ba2da30205d1d80d2e8c4017d3f6358a9)

## Preview scopes

- candidate-status:read
- link-sessions:create
- vibe-candidates:write

## Preview operations

- POST /oauth/token — Not callable
- POST /connectives/v1/link-sessions — Not callable
- GET /connectives/v1/link-sessions/{session_id} — Not callable
- POST /connectives/v1/grants/{grant_id}/vibe-candidates — Not callable
- GET /connectives/v1/grants/{grant_id}/candidates/{candidate_id} — Not callable

## Listing and submission rules

A merged manifest changes a public listing only. It never grants credentials, callbacks, provider access, runtime registration, or production activation. New external listings are proposed with no public API access until a separate reviewed promotion.

## Status legend

- Connected: bespoke partner integration exists today.
- First party: Main's World operated capability.
- Coming soon: represented, not connected or callable.
- Proposed: reviewed listing, not connected or activated.
- Wishlist: future possibility; no connector promised.
